missions.briefing: Mara's till script adds wrong — a client's totals are off. Read the error, fix total(), prove it with the tests.
missions.starter:
# Mission 2: Mara's Broken Total
# Fix total() so it sums the list. (Hint: read the loop out loud.)
import sys

def total(prices):
    s = 0
    for p in prices:
        s = p  # BUG: this replaces instead of accumulating
    return s

prices = [int(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
print(total(prices))
missions.title: Mara's Broken Total

missions.briefing: Rafi's discount script is embarrassing — it prints the discount instead of the price. 20% off means the customer pays 80%.
missions.starter:
# Mission 5: Discount Day
# Fix discount() so it returns the price AFTER 20% off.
import sys

def discount(price):
    return price * 0.2  # BUG: this is the discount, not the final price

prices = [float(x) for x in sys.stdin.read().split()]
for p in prices:
    print(discount(p))
missions.title: Discount Day
